record.title: Adaptations to the AI Regulation: Safe use, effective control and support for innovation (SOU 2025:101)
record.original_title: Anpassningar till AI-förordningen – Säker användning, effektiv kontroll och stöd för innovation (SOU 2025:101)
record.summary: Report of the government inquiry on the EU AI Regulation proposing a new Swedish act and ordinance to supplement it. It proposes eleven market surveillance authorities and two notifying authorities, Swedac and the Medical Products Agency. The Post and Telecom Authority (PTS) would hold main responsibility, coordinate and be the single point of contact, and the Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY) would lead on prohibited practices. It also proposes reprimands and administrative fines that can be imposed on public authorities too, confidentiality rules including protection of incident reporting, an AI regulatory sandbox set up by PTS, and approval of testing in real-world conditions.
record.notes: Report of the Inquiry on the AI Regulation, a special inquiry the Government appointed on 19 September 2024 under committee terms of reference Dir. 2024:83. It was published on 6 October 2025 and sent out for consultation on 11 November 2025 (Fi2025/01969). It proposes that the supplementary act, the supplementary ordinance and the other amendments enter into force on 2 August 2026, and it recommends that the Government designate market surveillance and notifying authorities at least temporarily while its proposals are prepared. The report includes a summary in English. As of October 2026 the Government's page for the report lists no referral to the Council on Legislation and no government bill.

verification.note: Stored and read in this run: the Government's page for SOU 2025:101 on regeringen.se (title, publication on 6 October 2025, the inquiry's proposals in brief, and the related-documents panel showing no Council on Legislation referral and no government bill; last checked 17 Oct 2026, unchanged since 11 Oct), the full report as a PDF (998 pages, with its Swedish and English summaries, the 19 September 2024 appointment and the proposed entry into force), and the consultation page (Fi2025/01969, published 11 November 2025, updated 23 February 2026). The English title is a rendering; the report's English summary gives no English title. Version 1's statement that PTS describes Sweden as awaiting supplementary legislation, and the interim designation of 4 June 2026, rest on SE-02's sources, not on this record's, and were removed from the notes; the recommendation of a temporary designation is in the report itself.

status.quote: En proposition är ett förslag från regeringen till riksdagen om ny lag eller ändring av gällande lag. Inga dokument

issuing_body.quote: Regeringen beslutade den 19 september 2024 att tillkalla en särskild utredare

legal_force.quote: Utredningen föreslår att de svenska bestämmelser som behöver komplettera AI-förordningen huvudsakligen ska samlas i en ny lag och en ny förordning.

summary.quote: Utredningen föreslår ett system för marknadsövervakning, marknadskontroll, styrning och kontroll av efterlevnad som består av elva marknadskontrollmyndigheter och två anmälande myndigheter.
The Inquiry proposes that Swedac and the Medical Products Agency be notifying authorities under the AI Act.
the Swedish Post and Telecom Authority (PTS) will be the market surveillance authority with primary responsibility for the AI Act.
PTS i egenskap av marknadskontrollmyndighet med huvudsakligt ansvar för AI-förordningen, ska vara samordnande marknadskontrollmyndighet och att den myndigheten också ska vara gemensam kontaktpunkt.
the Inquiry proposes that the IMY be primarily responsible for market surveillance of the prohibited AI practices in Article 5.
The Inquiry proposes that reprimands and administrative fines as well as injunctions with or without fines also be imposed on public authorities.
a new provision to protect incident reporting in the Public Access and Secrecy Act (2009:400) (OSL)
Post- och telestyrelsen föreslås inrätta en sådan regulatorisk sandlåda.
The Inquiry proposes that these authorities be the PTS, the IMY and the FI in accordance with the division of responsibili- ties

notes.quote: Regeringen beslutade den 19 september 2024 att tillkalla en särskild utredare
Dir. 2024:83 Trygg och tillförlitlig användning av AI
Utredningen föreslår att kompletteringslagen, kompletteringsförord- ningen och övriga författningsändringar ska träda i kraft den 2 augusti 2026.
Utredningen anser dock att det finns skäl för regeringen att i vart fall tillfälligt utse marknadskontrollmyndigheter och anmälande myndigheter
The AI Act entered into force on 1 August 2024. However, the majority of its provisions will not start to apply until 2 August 2026.
En lagrådsremiss är ett utkast till lag som regeringen lämnar till Lagrådet för granskning. Inga dokument

judgment.status_reasoning: A government inquiry report (SOU) published on 6 Oct 2025 and sent out for consultation; it has no legal force. The Government's page lists no Council on Legislation referral and no bill, and nothing replaces it, so 'Published (non-binding, current)' stands.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Government-commissioned report proposing the national implementation of the EU AI Act (authorities, sanctions, sandbox); in scope without a note.
